items.title: The Portfolio Blueprint for $11,100 a Month in Dividend Income Without Selling a Single Share
items.summary: Eight holdings, one big idea: live on payouts and never touch your shares. But every pick hides a catch, from shrinking distributions to tax surprises, and one slot exists purely to protect you when a dividend gets cut.

items.title: Have AT&T's Dividends Been Worth It?
items.summary: AT&T sells wireless plans and fiber internet. It pays part of the cash it earns to holders as dividends. Over the past year alone, dividends added about 4.3 percentage points to the stock's return. A percentage point is the plain difference between two returns. The share price, though, has trailed the market. So what did a five-year holder end up with once every dividend is counted.

items.title: AT&T Is Up 10% in a Month. Steve Eisman Calls the Big Three Carriers “Uninvestable.” Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAT&T stock is up 10% in the past month as the broader market fell and investors moved into cheap, high-yielding stocks. SpaceX wants to build a fourth US carrier, but the Boost Mobile network it wants to buy runs on AT&T and T-Mobile, which reportedly plan to cut it off.
